segments.t: Barinov has put money on the match, and he now needs caviar for the restaurant. Timur, the supplier, arrives with five kilos, and the two of them taste it. Here is how they put it.
Шеф, вот всё, как мы договаривались.
Ты принёс полный заказ чёрной икры?
Здесь ровно пять килограмм самой лучшей икры.
Ты точно уверен, что она свежая?
Обижаешь меня такими странными вопросами, дорогой брат!
Для нашего ресторана подходит только лучший выбор.
Это самая свежая икра во всей Москве.
Такой продукт требует строгого контроля качества.
Даже чиновники на завтрак едят вчерашнюю икру.
Тогда давай быстро проверим её вкус.
На, возьми ложку и попробуй сам.
Сейчас я сразу оценю твой дорогой товар.
First line first.
Шеф, вот всё, как мы договаривались.
договаривались

'Chef, here is everything, just as we agreed.' Timur opens with this The speaker uses 'here's everything", the way you hand something over. This The speaker uses 'we agreed' ends in a short form after a vowel: you agree with one another.
Ты принёс полный заказ чёрной икры?
икры

'Did you bring the complete order of black caviar?' This They express 'of black caviar' by changes both words from their base forms. This word means "you brought". Barinov uses the informal "you" to the supplier.
Здесь ровно пять килограмм самой лучшей икры.
ровно

'Here are exactly five kilograms of prime caviar.' This We hear 'exactly' gives the word from Barinov's bet, "exactly one hundred thousand". In speech, this We hear 'five kilograms' often drops the ending. This phrase means "the very best".
Ты точно уверен, что она свежая?
свежая

'Are you definitely sure that it is fresh?' The word for caviar is she-word, so "it" is "she", and this When they say 'fresh' takes the she-word form. This phrase means "definitely sure", with When they say 'sure' used for a man.
Обижаешь меня такими странными вопросами, дорогой брат!
Обижаешь

'You offend me with such strange questions, dear brother!' This Notice the part 'you offend' comes back from Max's phrase "don't be offended". On its own it is popular speech for "you insult me". Men call each other "brother", to be friendly.
Для нашего ресторана подходит только лучший выбор.
подходит

'Only the highest grade is suitable for our restaurant.' This word, literally "comes up to", is "suits" or "fits". This phrase means "for our restaurant": the word for restaurant changes its ending after the connecting In Russian, 'for' translates. This word means "choice".
Это самая свежая икра во всей Москве.
самая

'This is the freshest caviar in all of Moscow.' This Here, 'the most fresh' shows, is how you say "the freshest". This phrase means "in all of Moscow": the base words change their endings after the connecting Here, 'in' shows.
Такой продукт требует строгого контроля качества.
требует

'Such a product requires strict quality control.' This The way to express 'requires', is the action word Louis used for patience. This The way to express 'control of quality', has two words in the "of" form. The word for control is borrowed.
Даже чиновники на завтрак едят вчерашнюю икру.
вчерашнюю

'Even officials eat yesterday's caviar for breakfast.' This 'yesterday' is used heres", grows from 'yesterday' is used here. This phrase means "for breakfast". This phrase means "even officials". Timur is boasting that his caviar is fresher than theirs.
Тогда давай быстро проверим её вкус.
проверим

'Then let's quickly check its taste.' This Listen to how 'let's check", is also in Barinov's phrase "I'll check the work". This Listen to how 'taste', is the root of Listen to how 'tasty'. This word makes it "let's".
На, возьми ложку и попробуй сам.
попробуй

'Here, take a spoon and try it yourself.' This word here means "here you go", not "on". It is what you say when handing something over. This word is "try", and with food it means "taste". This word is "a spoon".
Сейчас я сразу оценю твой дорогой товар.
оценю

'Now I will immediately evaluate your expensive goods.' This They express 'I' byll evaluate", is the action word in Barinov's phrase "at how much did you value". This word means both "expensive" and "dear". This word is "goods". Time to hear it all again.

Здесь ровно пять килограмм самой лучшей икры.

The caviar is tasted, and the bill comes next. It's a short pause before things go wrong. Catch you next time.
Пока!
